steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Dark adaptation takes 20–30 minutes; avoid white light — use red light to preserve night vision | Key Fact: Averted vision (looking slightly to the side) uses rod cells, which are more sensitive to faint light | Key Fact: Binoculars are excellent for beginners — 10×50 is a recommended specification | Key Fact: Always use a solar filter or projection method when observing the Sun; NEVER look directly at the Sun

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from practical observing skills, and one past-paper question.
